Services surrendered. From my TSC perspective, a loading dock and compactor guide need to be developed by Risk and safety to be rolled out. There are two pressure washer vehicles that’s been used which is not for public road use. One was in the workshop for repairs to be returned on the day of the audit. The other vehicle was inspected and in good condition. It was recommended that safety first aid kit be placed in each vehicle.
